data.gender_notes: Barbabas is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Βαρβασ, meaning 'son of the exalted one'. Barbabas has its roots in the Hebrew Barabbas, meaning 'son of the father'. In the New Testament, Barabbas is mentioned as a man who was released from prison instead of Jesus at the request of the crowd. The name Barbabas carries the meaning “Strong, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Barbabas usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Barbabas total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Barbabas is chosen for its meaning “Strong, Exalted” and the hope that the child embodies it.
